dolomites.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking, with limestone spires and alpine pastures reached by cable cars, gondolas and chairlifts that lift hikers onto ridge-top trails at Seceda, Lagazuoi and Alpe di Siusi, Europe's largest high alpine meadow. The Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop is the classic moderate day hike, and the 75-mile Alta Via 1 is a 10-day hut-to-hut trek from Lago di Braies to Belluno. Seceda, Lago di Braies and Tre Cime are crowded in summer, with timed lift slots, car restrictions or tolls. The season runs from late June to September.

months.7: The high trails are completely clear, offering spectacular views of the spires. Huts and lifts are all running, and afternoon thunderstorms are common, so hikers aim to be off the ridges by early afternoon. Seceda, Lago di Braies and Tre Cime are at their most crowded.
months.8: The high trails are completely clear, offering spectacular views of the spires. Huts and lifts are all running, and afternoon thunderstorms are common, so hikers aim to be off the ridges by early afternoon. Seceda, Lago di Braies and Tre Cime are at their most crowded.
months.9: The crowds thin and the weather stabilizes with crisp, clear air, making it the best time for the high routes and hut-to-hut treks. Lifts and huts are still running for most of the month, and September is noticeably quieter than August.
